title: City Brew Coffee — AM Review Board
subtitle: Keith approved moving forward with all three fresh City Brew summer drink concepts: The Condensation Test, Choose Your Chill Level, and The…
guardrails: Use real client assets where possible. AI mockups are visual direction only. Do not invent product claims, offers, or drink names.

ideas.title: The Condensation Test
ideas.dependency: Approved iced summer drink name, final product visual, and product-accurate ingredient/topping visibility.
ideas.next_action: Lead concept. Capture one iced drink macro sequence and confirm drink name for end card.
ideas.summary: A thumb-stopping macro Reel that proves the drink is cold and craveable before the viewer even reads the drink name. The concept sells summer refreshment through condensation, ice, tactile sound, and a City Brew handoff instead of generic 'cool off' copy.
ideas.visual_direction: Create a 6-8 second 9:16 Reel: macro condensation beads on an iced City Brew cup; ice clink/cup set-down/straw or lid snap; drink swirl or texture; the cup leaves a cold ring on the counter; final City Brew logo cup or handoff end card. Natural counter/window light is enough if the cup visibly looks cold. Use crisp tactile audio if available.
ideas.on_asset_copy: If the cup doesn’t sweat, is it even summer? / Cold proof: passed. / [APPROVED DRINK NAME] at City Brew.
ideas.caption: If your summer drink passes the condensation test, you’re in the right place. Try [APPROVED DRINK NAME] on your next City Brew stop.
assets_needed: Macro footage/photo of condensation, ice, lid/straw, drink texture
City Brew cup/logo visible for final frame
Approval of exact drink name before final export

ideas.title: Choose Your Chill Level
ideas.dependency: Approved drink-to-lane mapping, priority drink lineup, and taste notes/flavor lanes.
ideas.next_action: Build Story structure now; finalize lane reveal once drink mapping is approved.
ideas.summary: A useful Story/carousel order-helper that turns City Brew’s summer drink lineup into clear craving lanes: light refresh, coffee cold, or treat mode. It helps customers pick quickly without feeling like a menu board.
ideas.visual_direction: Build a four-frame IG Story: opening lineup with 'Choose your chill level'; poll for Light refresh vs Treat mode; poll/quiz for Coffee-forward vs Sweet + creamy; lane reveal mapping each lane to an approved drink; final screenshot/save CTA. Carousel backup: cover, one slide per lane, final 'Save this for your next City Brew stop.' Keep large type and clean product cards, not crowded menu-board design.
ideas.on_asset_copy: Choose your chill level. / Light refresh. / Coffee cold. / Treat mode. / Screenshot your summer lane.
ideas.caption: Not sure where to start with summer drinks? Pick your chill level, save your lane, and make the next City Brew stop easy.
assets_needed: 2-3 approved summer drink photos or one lineup shot
Approved taste notes/flavor lanes for each drink
Brand assets for simple lane-card design
Poll/quiz sticker guidance for Story frames
Approval that lanes do not imply unapproved customizations

ideas.title: The 2 PM Melt
ideas.dependency: One approved iced summer drink visual and confirmation of product name/availability.
ideas.next_action: Shoot after hero drink is chosen; use object-led routine props and avoid active driving/location claims.
ideas.summary: A real-life summer routine Reel where the day starts melting — work, errands, heat, scattered tasks — and a City Brew iced drink becomes the small afternoon reset. This makes the summer drink feel useful and emotionally true, not just pretty.
ideas.visual_direction: Create a 7-10 second 9:16 Reel: sticky notes/laptop/receipt/errand bag to open with 'When summer hits at 2 PM'; sunglasses/keys/fan/packed-day props showing the day feeling full; City Brew drink lands on counter/desk/table; macro condensation/ice/sip/handoff; final product hero with City Brew logo and drink name. Keep it adult/real and not chaotic-parent content.
ideas.on_asset_copy: When summer hits at 2 PM… / The melt is real. / Reset secured. / [APPROVED DRINK NAME] — your afternoon reset.
ideas.caption: Some summer days need a second start. Make [APPROVED DRINK NAME] your afternoon reset on the next City Brew stop.
assets_needed: Props: sticky notes, receipt, keys, sunglasses, fan, tote, summer bag, laptop
Approval of drink name and availability/date limits
